name: Old-man's-whiskers
desc: Old-man's-whiskers (Geum triflorum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 29 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Geum triflorum, commonly known as prairie smoke, old man's whiskers, or three-flowered avens, is a spring-blooming perennial herbaceous plant of the Rosaceae family.
